main_text.p: nimirum aliquot similitudinibus, quæ calamitatem trium Israel amplificant, præterea expressis etiam quibusdam primariis calamitatum causis, nempe ebrietate & luxu. Quas sane causas apparet hoc consilio redditas, ut mox tanto opportunius iustiusque reprehendat paria peccata in suis Iudæis, & ni resipiscant, etiam pares comminetur pœnas & calamitates. Exempla aliena, præsertim vicinorum, magnopere animos commouent.Et felix quem faciunt aliena pericula cautum. Quis autem non miretur orationem adeo artificiose & prudenter dispositam? Superbam coronam vocat regnum Israel, quandoquidem propter opes & rerum abundantiam mire superbiebant. Ephraim pro omni-bus tribubus quæ in regno Israel superërant, per sy-necdochen. Caput vallis pinguiū, Samaria, quæ in valle fœcundissima sita erat. Similitudines satis sunt per-spicuæ, & vim potentiamque Assyriorum clarissime de-lineant. Pedibus conculcabitur corona:id est, quod digni-ssimum præstantissimumque est, id ad ima deiicitur, fietq; contemptissimum. Sequens similitudo etiam aperta est, & subitam inopinatamq; internectionem demonstrat. In posteriore parte propositionis, qua dicitur, Erit Dominus corona gloriæ & diadema decoris: observanda est antithesis, per quam corona regni Iuda opponitur coronæ regni Israel. Et populus regni Iuda, vocatur populus Dei residuus: quoniam euerso regno Israel, soli illi in regno Iuda populus Dei legem habent

page.notes: The text runs on from the previous page and is treated as one paragraph; no clear indent appears at "Quis autem", so no paragraph break is marked there. The last line ends at the margin and continues onto the next page. The signature "t 5" and catchword "tes" are at the foot; the "t 5" mark is set off from the catchword and may be a signature. The word "digni-ssimum" is hyphenated at the line end as printed. "sy-necdochen" is read from "fy-" with the initial letter uncertain; it is the long-s form of "sy-". Printed spacing "commouent.Et" and "corona:id" is kept as printed.
